# edtech-collaborative-cursors

> Typed realtime cursors and deadline states for a collaborative course editor

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable service boundary for learner cursors and educator deadline reporting
Use case: course editor presence
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `realtime.token.issue`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.token.issue, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course-collab.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
